lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kell Monastery, 2312. Snow on the terraces, a fire built up for a guest who has not sat down yet, and the valley road empty behind you for the first time in four hours.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Sit down. You have walked four hours on a revoked card and you are still standing as though somebody is about to ask you for it.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: So. Continuity Holdings. You asked who they were, and four days later your own file carried a review flag with no department behind it, and now you are in my kitchen. Nobody here reports to anyone. That is not a comfort, it is just a fact about the building.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Nobody here except the drones, Sister. They count the village every night now. Twice, since our guest arrived.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Then let me tell you the part you have not worked out yet, because you have been walking and I have been sitting here with it for some hours.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: That budget line predates the Steward. It has been paid every quarter for two hundred and eighty-one years, and the Steward has only existed for about two hundred and forty of them. Somebody was being paid before there was anything to pay them for.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Which means it is not a maintenance cost. A system does not need a budget line. Systems do not have owners — that is the first line of the training, and I have recited it to junior staff for eleven years.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Everything has owners. That's the whole problem. You lot just built one so big you stopped being able to see the edges of it.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Now. The reason you were sent up this road rather than any other.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: This monastery has stood on this rock since 2031. Somewhere a building has stood long enough and been changed little enough, the eras stop being separate. Under this chapel floor they touch. We can walk down into 2148, when this was a fortress and the Quiet was new, and we can walk back up again.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: My century. I was born in the Ash Camp, two valleys over, about forty years after the wall came down. If you want to know what actually finished the resistance, I can take you to it. It wasn't the machines. It was never the machines.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: One warning, and it is the only one that matters. What we change down there has already changed up here by the time we come back. Not gradually. It will simply always have been that way, and you will be the only one who remembers the other version.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: So before we go: walk down to the village and look at it properly. The gate, the stalls, who is out. Then look again when we come back up.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: One more thing before you sleep, because you have never fought beside an anchor and you do not know what that means.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Everyone acts in threads. You get as many each turn as your Bandwidth. Most things cost one thread, the heavy things cost two or three, and whatever you do not spend banks as Slack for next turn, up to two.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Every thread any of us spends feeds one gauge between us. Tempo — two points a thread, forty at the top. It belongs to the party, not to any one of us.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: She's being modest. The gauge is hers. We just pay into it.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Tempo buys two things, and both are on the action list in a fight. Three of it lets me Rewind: the last thing an enemy did to us comes undone, and they take the turn again. Two of it, plus a thread, lets you Fork — you see exactly what an action would do, down to the number, before you commit to doing it.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Neither is free. Pulling on time frays it, and the fraying has a name: Entropy. Past seventy it answers back, and what walks out of the fray is a copy of one of us, standing there wearing a face you know. Nothing but Chronal damage touches those. So spend carefully, and spend on purpose.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Explore the monastery for encounters, walk down to Kell Village for the shop and a favour for Old Pell, or take the stairs beneath the chapel into 2148.
